content: {"episode_id":"ep-05163","cpt":"93226","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"CPT code 93226 was billed for a 48-hour Holter monitoring study ordered for a patient with a history of recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), episodes of dizziness (R42), and a recent syncopal event (R55). The monitoring was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and to guide further management, as documented in the clinical indication note submitted with this appeal. We therefore request reconsideration of the PR-204 denial, as the service is clinically indicated for this patient's documented presentation."}
